To implement this in idiomatic Ruby, use the splat operator (`*args`) to capture all positional arguments and forward them.

```ruby
def wrapper(*args)
  target(*args)
end

# Example usage:
def target(a, b, c)
  puts "Received: #{a}, #{b}, #{c}"
end

wrapper(10, "hello", :world) 
# Output: Received: 10, hello, :world
```
